meta.defaultTitle: Vela Hotel — Boutique hotel in Galata, Istanbul
meta.defaultDescription: Vela Hotel is a 24-room boutique hotel in Galata, Beyoğlu, Istanbul. Set in an 1890 building, a 250-metre walk from Galata Tower.

room.metaDescription: The {name} at Vela Hotel in {neighborhood}, {city} measures {size} m² and sleeps {guests}. Breakfast is included in the rate.

rooms.metaDescription: Vela Hotel has {types} room types across {total} rooms. Size, occupancy, bed and nightly starting rates are listed on this page.
rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.lead: Three room types, {total} rooms in total. The building's own geometry left a different plan on every floor, so no room is a copy of another.

terrace.metaDescription: Breakfast at Vela Hotel is served on the terrace floor from 07:30 to 10:30 and is included in the rate. The terrace bar opens after 16:00. There is no restaurant.
terrace.title: Breakfast and terrace
terrace.lead: There is no restaurant. There are two things instead: a breakfast table laid every morning, and a roof terrace that opens in the late afternoon.

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.body: 07:30 to 10:30 on the terrace floor, included with every room type. Cheese and olives come weekly from Kadıköy; the bread arrives each morning from the bakery below the street. Eggs are cooked to order.

terrace.title: Terrace
terrace.body: On the roof, open after 16:00. It faces the Golden Horn and the far shore. There is a short drinks and meze list; no dinner service.

honesty.title: What there isn't
honesty.body: No room service, no pool, no spa, no gym. The building dates from 1890 and has no lift. We say this upfront so your expectations are the right ones.

location.metaDescription: Vela Hotel is at {street} in {neighborhood}, {city}. It is a 250-metre walk from Galata Tower and 700 metres from Karaköy.
location.title: Location and getting here
location.lead: {street} is one of the steepest and quietest streets in Galata. It is closed to traffic, so the last few hundred metres are on foot.

metro.title: Metro
metro.body: Şişhane station on the M2 line is 550 metres away, a 7-minute walk. Head towards Tünel as you come out.

tram.title: Tram
tram.body: 700 metres from Karaköy stop on the T1 line. The climb is steep; alternatively take the Tünel funicular up and walk 400 metres.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.body: Serdar-ı Ekrem Street is closed to traffic. Ask the driver to drop you at Galata Tower square; the hotel is 250 metres further on.

foot.title: Arriving with luggage
foot.body: The street is cobbled and sloped. If you are arriving with heavy luggage we offer valet service to a partner car park 300 metres away; let us know in advance.

about.metaDescription: Vela Hotel is a {rooms}-room boutique hotel in a {year} apartment building in {neighborhood}, {city}. The façade was preserved through the renovation.
about.title: The building and us
about.lead: An apartment building from {year}. The façade never changed; the inside was rebuilt once.

paragraphs.building: The building went up in {year} as a family apartment house. Serdar-ı Ekrem Street was one of the newest streets in Galata at the time; the stonework on the façade and the iron balcony railings are still where they were on the first day.
paragraphs.restoration: The renovation was completed in {since}. The façade was left untouched and the load-bearing walls were kept. Because the floor plans were not altered, no room is a copy of another — each of the {rooms} rooms follows the building's own geometry.
paragraphs.today: Today there are {rooms} rooms, a breakfast floor and a roof terrace. There is no lift; the building was not designed for one and adding it would have meant cutting into the structure. Two ground-floor rooms are set aside for guests who would rather not take the stairs.

faq.metaDescription: Check-in at Vela Hotel is 15:00 and check-out is 12:00. Breakfast is included, pets are welcome, and there is no car park or lift.
faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.lead: The things guests ask most often before booking. If your question isn't answered here, give us a call.

hero.title: A quiet threshold in the middle of the city
hero.lead: At the top of Serdar-ı Ekrem Street, inside an apartment building whose façade was never touched. Close the door and Istanbul's hum stays outside.

experience.title: In the hotel and around it

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.body: On the terrace floor, 07:30 to 10:30. Cheese and olives come weekly from Kadıköy; the bread arrives every morning from the bakery below the street.

terrace.title: Terrace
terrace.body: On the roof, open from late afternoon. It faces the Golden Horn and the far shore; after six the light turns the whole façade orange.

neighborhood.title: Neighbourhood
neighborhood.body: {neighborhood} was built to be walked. Step out and turn right: the street takes you down between design shops and old apartment doors.

location.title: How far is what
location.lead: {street} is one of the steepest and quietest streets in Galata. Every distance below is on foot.

one.quote: The stairs were hard on the first day, then they became the best part of it.
one.author: Elif K.

two.quote: You can see the tower from the window. We never closed the curtain.
two.author: Tomas W.

three.quote: In a place with twenty-four rooms, the person at reception knows your name by the second day.
three.author: Merve A.
